annotations.title: Estimate benefit cap and coverage gap

description: Compute the income replacement gap between a group long-term disability benefit cap and a target replacement of earned income. Pure math, no external calls. Unauthenticated.

annual_income.description: Gross earned income in US dollars.

benefit_taxable.description: Whether group benefits would be taxable (true if employer pays premiums). Default true.

group_monthly_cap.description: Group LTD policy monthly benefit cap in US dollars.

marginal_tax_rate.description: Combined federal + state marginal rate as a decimal. Default 0.35.

name: estimate_benefit_cap_gap
